question: ** Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**signed**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **noticed: **
 treat (someone) as worthy of recognition or attention.
 
 
• **signed: **authorize (a document or other written or printed material) by attaching a signature.
 
• **witnessed: **see (an event, typically a crime or accident) happen.
 
• **attended: **be present at (an event, meeting, or function).
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**signed**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
 
• **Example**: *She **signed **__a contract with a modeling agency*.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2**.

**The complete passage is**: Air India's sale to Tata Group was announced on 8 October last year and a Letter of Intent (LoI) was **(1) issued** to the Tata Group confirming the government's willingness to sell **(2) its**100% stake in the airline. On 25 October, the Centre **(3) signed** the share purchase agreement (SPA) for this deal. The Indian government handed **(4) over** Air India to the Tata Group on 27 January, nearly 69 years after it was taken from the conglomerate.** (5) joyous**, Ratan Tata shared his views on Twitter stating 'Welcome Back, Air India'.
